story: Thinking Machines releases Inkling 2 Mini, a free open-weights AI model that runs on a laptop

sources.name: Thinking Machines Lab announcement (Introducing Inkling 2 Mini)

source_line: Sources: Thinking Machines Lab, The Next Web, VentureBeat

segments.label: THIS WEEK IN AI
segments.title: A free AI model that runs on your laptop
segments.narration: A free AI model now runs on your laptop, even offline.

segments.label: WHAT HAPPENED
segments.title: Inkling 2 Mini is released
segments.narration: Thinking Machines Lab released Inkling two Mini on November twentieth, with open weights.

segments.label: HOW IT WORKS
segments.title: It loops its middle layers 3 times
segments.narration: It loops its middle layers three times per token. It needs about twenty gigabytes of memory.

segments.label: WHAT IT MEANS FOR YOU
segments.title: Local AI, with one catch
segments.point: Weaker at chat and complex instructions
segments.narration: Your data can stay on your own machine. The catch: it is weaker at multi-turn chat and complex instructions.

segments.label: OUR TAKE
segments.title: Test it on one task first
segments.narration: Our take: test it on one task before trusting it with customers.
